+    # Convert inputs

+    # Validate shapes
+    if arr_with.shape != arr_call.shape or arr_with.shape != arr_no.shape:
+        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")

+        raise ValueError("Input matrices must be 2-dimensional")
+    if arr_with.size == 0:
+        raise ValueError("Input matrices must not be empty")
+    # Validate finiteness and nonpositivity
+    for arr in [arr_with, arr_call, arr_no]:
+        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
+            raise ValueError("Input matrices must be finite")
+        if np.any(arr > 0):
+            raise ValueError("Input matrices must be nonpositive")
+    # Compute margins
+    margins = np.sum(arr_with + arr_call - arr_no, axis=1)
+    keep_mask = margins > tau_filter
